From Stdlib Require Import String List NArith.
From QuickChick Require Import QuickChick.
From ConCert.Execution Require Import Blockchain Containers ContractCommon Serializable.
From ConCert.Examples.EIP20 Require Import EIP20Token.
Import ListNotations.
Local Open Scope string_scope.

Definition sep : string := ", ".

Definition string_of_FMap {A B : Type}
    `{countable.Countable A} `{stdpp.base.EqDecision A}
    (showA : A -> string) (showB : B -> string) (m : FMap A B) : string :=
  "[" ++ String.concat "; "
    (map (fun '(a, b) => showA a ++ "-->" ++ showB b) (FMap.elements m)) ++ "]".

#[export] Instance showFMap {A B : Type}
    `{countable.Countable A} `{stdpp.base.EqDecision A}
    `{Show A} `{Show B} : Show (FMap A B) :=
  {| show := string_of_FMap show show |}.

Definition unit_address_eqb (_ _ : unit) : bool := true.

Lemma unit_address_eqb_spec (a b : unit) :
    Bool.reflect (a = b) (unit_address_eqb a b).
Proof. destruct a, b. constructor. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition Base : ChainBase :=
  {| Address := unit;
     address_eqb := unit_address_eqb;
     address_eqb_spec := unit_address_eqb_spec;
     address_is_contract _ := false |}.

#[export] Instance showAddress : Show (@Address Base) :=
  {| show _ := "unused" |}.

#[export] Instance showTokenState : Show (@EIP20Token.State Base) :=
  {| show s := "State{total_supply: " ++ show s.(EIP20Token.total_supply) ++ sep
      ++ "balances: " ++ show s.(EIP20Token.balances) ++ sep
      ++ "allowances: " ++ show s.(EIP20Token.allowances) ++ "}" |}.

Theorem source_empty_state :
  @show _ showTokenState
    (@EIP20Token.build_state Base 0%N AddressMap.empty AddressMap.empty) =
  "State{total_supply: 0, balances: [], allowances: []}"%string.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

abbrev FMap (κ : Type) (ν : Type) := Finmap (fun _ : κ => ν)

namespace FMap

dependencies.name: elements
dependencies.target_text:
def elements {κ ν : Type} [LinearOrder κ] (map : FMap κ ν) : List (κ × ν) :=
  (map.keys.sort (· ≤ ·)).filterMap fun key => (map.lookup key).map fun value => (key, value)

dependencies.name: showValue
dependencies.target_text: def showValue [Show α] (value : α) : String := Show.render value

dependencies.name: showMap
dependencies.target_text:
def showMap [LinearOrder κ] [Show κ] [Show ν] (map : FMap κ ν) : String :=
  "{" ++ String.intercalate "; " ((FMap.elements map).map fun (k, v) =>
    showValue k ++ " ↦ " ++ showValue v) ++ "}"
